from click._termui_impl import ProgressBar
bar = ProgressBar(None, length=1000)
for pos in (0, 1, 375, 999, 1000):
    bar.pos = pos
    expected = f"{int(bar.pct * 100): 4}%"[1:]
    assert bar.format_pct() == expected
    assert bar.format_pct(decimals=0) == expected
bar.pos = 375
assert bar.format_pct(decimals=1) == "37.5%"
assert bar.format_pct(decimals=3) == "37.500%"
bar.pos = 0
assert bar.format_pct(decimals=2) == "0.00%"
bar.finished = True
assert bar.format_pct(decimals=2) == "100.00%"
try:
    bar.format_pct(decimals=-1)
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError("negative precision accepted")
try:
    bar.format_pct(1)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError("positional precision accepted")
print("Focused checks passed")

arguments.command:
@'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/click/_termui_impl.py')
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:src/click/_termui_impl.py'])
current = p.read_bytes()
old_lines = original.splitlines(keepends=True)
new_lines = current.splitlines(keepends=True)
import difflib
result = []
for tag, i, j, k, l in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, [x.rstrip(b'\r\n') for x in old_lines], [x.rstrip(b'\r\n') for x in new_lines]).get_opcodes():
    result.extend(old_lines[i:j] if tag == 'equal' else new_lines[k:l])
p.write_bytes(b''.join(result))
'@ | python -; git diff --check; git --no-pager diff --stat; git status --short --untracked-files=all
